content: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. For other cases, contact a poison control center without delay. In the United States, you can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. While using this medication, it is essential to undergo laboratory and/or medical tests, such as a complete blood count, liver function tests, skin examinations, or Pap smears, as recommended by your healthcare provider. Ensure that you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose of this medication, it is crucial to consult your doctor or pharmacist promptly to establish a new dosing schedule. Do not attempt to adjust the dosage on your own. For proper storage of this medication, refer to the product instructions or consult your pharmacist. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. When the medication is expired or no longer needed, discard it appropriately according to local disposal guidelines. Be aware that your medical condition may lead to complications during a medical emergency. It is important to inform healthcare professionals about your condition to ensure proper care. This information was last updated in May 2024. Please note that this summary does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this product and your individual health requirements. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not cover all potential drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs as well as herbal supplements, and share this list with your doctor and pharmacist. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this medication with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the relevant plan provider for the most up-to-date information.
